issues.title: H1 missing on /news/ and /coins/ pages
issues.what: H1 tag absent on two highest-traffic pages
issues.why: H1 is a primary on-page ranking signal. Missing H1 on news and coins pages = lost keyword authority on the most-visited sections
issues.fix:
Add

tag to NewsClient.tsx and coins/page.tsx. Example:

Crypto News & Market Data

if visual H1 conflicts with design

issues.title: JSON-LD structured data not rendering on any page
issues.what: layout.tsx has JSON-LD code but 0 structured data blocks detected on all audited pages
issues.why: No JSON-LD = no Google News rich results, no NewsArticle eligibility, no WebSite SearchAction sitelinks. Critical for news site
issues.fix: Verify JsonLd component renders in <head>. Check if Next.js 16 suppresses script tags in <head> with app router. Consider moving JSON-LD to page-level metadata or using next/script with strategy='beforeInteractive'

issues.title: Meta description and canonical missing on /news/
issues.what: Both meta description and canonical URL absent on /news/
issues.why: Missing canonical on a paginated/filterable news listing risks duplicate content penalties. Missing meta_desc = Google auto-generates snippet, often poor CTR
issues.fix: Add generateMetadata() to src/app/news/NewsClient.tsx or src/app/news/page.tsx returning description and canonical

issues.title: Viewport meta missing on homepage and /news/
issues.what: viewport meta tag not present on homepage and news page — Google Mobile-First indexing will flag as non-mobile-friendly
issues.why: Without viewport tag, mobile browsers zoom out to desktop width. Google ranks mobile version first — missing viewport = ranking penalty
issues.fix: Confirm viewport is in src/app/layout.tsx <head>. If using Next.js App Router, viewport should be exported via 'export const viewport' not a meta tag in <head>

issues.title: 156 coin images missing alt text on /coins/
issues.what: All coin logo images in the market cap table have no alt attribute
issues.why: Missing alt on 156 images = accessibility fail (WCAG 2.1 Level A) + missed keyword opportunities for image search
issues.fix: In CoinCard.tsx or coins/page.tsx, add alt={`${coin.name} logo`} to <Image> components for each coin

issues.title: llms.txt missing
issues.why: AI agents (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude Browse) use llms.txt to understand site structure. Missing = lower AI citation probability
issues.fix:
Create public/llms.txt with: # Coincu
> Intelligence platform for crypto news, prices, and market data

## Sections
- /news/ — Breaking crypto news
- /coins/ — Market cap rankings
- /predictions/ — Price predictions
- /reviews/ — Exchange reviews
- /glossary/ — Crypto terms A-Z

issues.title: Content-Security-Policy header missing
issues.why: Without CSP, XSS attacks can inject malicious scripts. Also required for high trust signals with Google Safe Browsing
issues.fix: Add CSP header in next.config.ts headers() or Railway environment. Start with report-only mode: Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'

issues.title: HSTS header missing
issues.why: SSL stripping vulnerability. Browsers won't enforce HTTPS on subsequent visits without HSTS
issues.fix: Add in next.config.ts: headers: [{ key: 'Strict-Transport-Security', value: 'max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains' }]

issues.title: OG Image missing on homepage
issues.why: When shared on X/Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn — no preview image = CTR drops 40-60%
issues.fix: Add og:image to layout.tsx metadata: openGraph: { images: [{ url: 'https://coincu.com/og-default.jpg', width: 1200, height: 630 }] }

issues.title: 33 images missing alt text on homepage
issues.what: Navigation icons, social icons, footer logo missing alt attributes
issues.why: Accessibility issue — screen readers skip these images. Also minor SEO signal
issues.fix: Add alt='' (empty string) for decorative icons, add descriptive alt for logos. Check LeftSidebarHeader.tsx and TopBar.tsx

issues.title: NewsArticle JSON-LD missing on article pages
issues.what: Individual news article pages likely missing NewsArticle schema
issues.why: NewsArticle schema required for Google News Top Stories carousel eligibility — biggest traffic opportunity for crypto news site
issues.fix: In src/app/news/[slug]/page.tsx, add NewsArticle JSON-LD with: headline, datePublished, dateModified, author, image, publisher

issues.title: Google Fonts loaded via external CSS (render-blocking)
issues.what: Arimo, JetBrains Mono, Space Mono loaded via Google Fonts external CSS in <head>
issues.why: External Google Fonts CSS is render-blocking. Adds 200-400ms to FCP on cold load
issues.fix: Use Next.js next/font/google to load fonts at build time instead. Eliminates external request and improves CLS/FCP

issues.title: /predictions/ blocked by Cloudflare when crawled
issues.what: TinyFish agent received Cloudflare challenge page instead of content
issues.why: If Googlebot also gets challenged, predictions pages won't be indexed. Check Search Console crawl stats
issues.fix: Add TinyFish/Googlebot user-agents to Cloudflare WAF allowlist. Verify in Google Search Console > Crawl Stats that predictions pages are indexed

issues.title: Author schema missing on article pages
issues.what: Article pages may not have Person schema for authors
issues.why: Google E-E-A-T: author schema with sameAs (LinkedIn, Twitter) boosts author authority signal. Critical for YMYL crypto content
issues.fix: In news/[slug]/page.tsx JSON-LD, add author: { @type: Person, name: authorName, url: authorProfileUrl, sameAs: [twitterUrl, linkedinUrl] }
